_howto: Each entry is one project card. 'slug' must match a file in data/projects/<slug>.json (the spotlight page). Remove an entry to hide a project; reorder entries to reorder cards. Set "hidden": true to keep the file but hide the card.

projects.title: WISE GRANOLA GOODS
projects.summary: A Square-powered ordering and subscription site for my San Diego granola business, built around a weekly bake cycle and three farmers-market pickups.

projects.title: Predicting Penny Stock Surges
projects.summary: A year of daily prices for 41 volatile tickers, engineered into features and run through similarity analysis and a decision-tree classifier to see if surges are predictable.

projects.title: AI Travel Guide
projects.summary: A React + Supabase app that asks Gemini for places in a new city, then ranks them against a 10-dimension preference profile with a weighted match score.
